title: Not So Multi But Still Block Packer 2099 3x3x3 Edition
description: Another <positive>breakthrough invention</positive> of <named>PLACERS™</named> (Packing Logistics And Controlled Erections of Rebuildable Structures) engineers - the lesser one, but not less artifice: <named>Not So Multi But Still Block Packer 2099 3x3x3 Edition</named>! This small device can do what most of us can, but less most of us want to do - turn complex details into not-less-complex machines! Just shove all the constituents of a whole into one of the BIG square holes this thing has, and BOOM - the <named>HOLE®</named> (Hidden and Originally Least Expected) mechanism will do all the <positive>hard work</positive> for you!

(The inner workings of this apparatus are considered a <warning>corporate secret</warning>, but we can assure you that it's most logical that to make this thing you have to unpack one of the newer models in a similar lineup of machines, specifically the <named>Multiblock Packer 3000 (Safety regulations edition)</named>)
